A blonde ponytail naturalist in burgundy top, navy trousers, brown boots, blue backpack with red straps. TWO small dark dogs peek from behind her backpack near her shoulders. A wicker basket stays on the ground just left of her, and a small patch of mushrooms is by her feet. Frames 0-3 notice a mushroom, bend knees and reach down; 4-6 gently pick it up; 7-9 straighten and inspect it with delight; 10-12 lower the mushroom into the basket; 13-15 release, smile and return to the starting standing pose. Last pose must blend back into first. 16 genuinely different authored poses, not duplicates or simple whole-character translations. Actual alpha transparency outside character and props. No text, logos, watermark or scenery. All pixels remain within their own cell; no glow bleeds into neighbors.
